title: Pump doesn't automatically reconnect like it used to
symptom: After updating to v3.2.0.4, every time the user changes the cartridge or battery of their Accu-chek Insight pump, AAPS does not automatically reestablish connection. The user must manually go to the pump tab and click 'refresh' to reconnect, otherwise the closed loop is not engaged and blood glucose levels go out of whack.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive root cause. Philoul suggests that the pump must be restarted after cartridge/battery change and that AAPS can only connect when the pump is started, but the user insists the pump is started. Philoul also mentions that communication requires the pump screen to be black, and that after waiting for the screen to turn black, connection should be automatic. No specific bug or change is identified.
fix: No definitive fix is provided. Philoul suggests ensuring the pump is restarted after cartridge change and waiting for the pump screen to turn black (about 1 minute) before expecting automatic reconnection. The user is asked to provide logs for further investigation.
evidence_quote: Communication needs at least to have a black screen on the pump, so immediatly after battery/cartridge change or after any user action on pump, you will have to wait until pump screen turn black (about 1 min according to user timeout). Then nothing else to do, on the next loop run with a required update on pump, communication is automatic without any additional manual action from user...
